title: Software Engineer — Agentic Systems & AI Products

summary.lv: Spotwise, strauji augošs adtech startaps, meklē programmatūras inženieri aģentisko sistēmu un MI produktu veidošanai reāllaikā darbojošās reklāmas inteliģences platformai raidorganizācijām.
summary.en: Spotwise, a fast-growing adtech startup, seeks a software engineer to build agentic systems and AI products for a real-time advertising intelligence platform serving broadcasters across 14+ countries.
